WITH telescope_averages AS (
  SELECT telescref, AVG(modindex) AS avg_modindex
  FROM signals
  GROUP BY telescref
  HAVING AVG(modindex) IS NOT NULL
), overall_average AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_modindex) AS avg_of_averages
  FROM telescope_averages
), above_average AS (
  SELECT ta.telescref, ta.avg_modindex, oa.avg_of_averages
  FROM telescope_averages ta
  CROSS JOIN overall_average oa
  WHERE ta.avg_modindex > oa.avg_of_averages
), normalized AS (
  SELECT telescref,
         avg_modindex,
         avg_modindex - avg_of_averages AS above_overall,
         avg_modindex / AVG(avg_modindex) OVER () AS ratio
  FROM above_average
)
SELECT telescref,
       avg_modindex,
       above_overall,
       ratio
FROM normalized
ORDER BY ratio DESC
LIMIT 10
